title: A simulation-deep reinforcement learning (SiRL) approach for epidemic control optimization
summary: The simulation compares intervention strategies in New Jersey and Kansas and reports scenario-specific infection/death tradeoffs, including vaccination and quarantine policies. These are simulated outcomes; they do not demonstrate effects on real-world COVID-19 transmission or establish public-health benefit.
ai_technology: A deep-reinforcement-learning governor selects intervention actions in an agent-based epidemic simulator.
